name: schedchie
description: Schedule posts, attach media, run approvals and read analytics on your Schedchie social accounts.

interface.longDescription:
Schedchie is a social media scheduler. With this plugin, your assistant works in your Schedchie account: you and the assistant write the post, and Schedchie schedules it and publishes it at the time you set.

Networks: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Google Business Profile, Discord, Slack, WordPress, Dev.to, Hashnode, Ghost, Pixelfed, Listmonk and X. Posting to X uses X credits, bought in the Schedchie web app.

What you can ask for:
- Which accounts are connected, and which need a reconnect before they can publish.
- Schedule a post on one or many accounts, with different text per network if you want it.
- Edit a scheduled post, retry a failed one, or delete one. Deleting is marked destructive, and the Schedchie skill tells the assistant to confirm first.
- Attach images or video from a link.
- Analytics for a date range on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Google Business Profile and Discord: followers, posts published and the per-post numbers each network reports.
- Approve or reject posts that teammates hold for review (Ultra and higher plans, owner only).

When you connect, the Schedchie sign-in screen lets you choose what the assistant may do. Anything you leave unticked is not available to it.

Limitations:
- Social accounts are connected in the Schedchie web app, not in the assistant.
- Numbers a network does not report are shown as missing, never as zero.
- Through the assistant, published posts cannot be edited, and deleting a post does not remove a post that is already live on the network.

You need a Schedchie account with an active plan or trial.
defaultPrompt: Schedule this on my LinkedIn and Bluesky accounts for Tuesday at 9:00 Berlin time: Our spring menu starts Monday.
What do I have scheduled for next week, and did anything fail?
How did each of my accounts do over the last 30 days?
